ios.desc:
Quit impulse shopping and keep the money. Low Buy helps you skip the buys you regret, one day at a time, with Penny cheering you on.

No bank logins. No spreadsheets. Just a simple daily check-in: did you buy today, or did you skip it?

BEAT THE URGE IN ONE MINUTE
Feel the pull to buy? Open Low Buy and tap the urge button. Breathe with Penny, think it through, and let it pass. Most urges fade in a minute.

SEE WHAT IT REALLY COSTS
Tell Low Buy what your habit usually costs and see it priced for a whole year. Then watch every skipped buy add to the money you kept.

KEEP YOUR STREAK GOING
Mark each day as a no buy day or a buy day on a clean calendar. Your streak grows, and a slip is forgiven, not punished. Tomorrow is a fresh start.

RULES THAT KEEP YOU ON TRACK
Make your own low buy plan: what you're cutting out and what's still allowed. Your rules are always one tap away when temptation hits.

KNOW WHAT SETS YOU OFF
Spot your triggers and your hardest days of the week, so you can plan ahead instead of giving in.

TRACK WHAT YOU WANT TO QUIT
Clothes, makeup, coffee, takeout, gadgets, books and many more. Start with two categories and focus where it matters.

MORE TO LOVE
• Home screen widgets to keep your streak in sight
• Share cards to celebrate your wins
• Gentle daily reminders
• iCloud backup, so your progress is safe
• Available in 13 languages

LOW BUY IS FREE
The daily check-in, streaks, the urge timer, the money you kept and your quit plan are free, with no time limit.

LOW BUY PLUS
Plus can help you more:
• Unlimited categories
• Insights on your triggers and full history
• Unlimited rules and goals
• Every widget, Lock Screen too
• Every share card style

Low Buy is free to use. Low Buy Plus is an optional upgrade, available as a yearly or monthly subscription, or as a one-time lifetime purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account when you confirm the purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings.
